items.title: What is a collateral loan?
items.detail: Something like property or an FD is kept as security.

items.title: What is non-collateral?
items.detail: You don't pledge anything. The lender looks at your profile, course and co-applicant.

items.title: Where's the difference?
items.detail: Interest rate, loan amount and approval conditions are different.

items.title: What to do first?
items.detail: Get offers from several lenders and compare the total repayment, not just the rate.

youtube.title: Education loans: collateral vs non-collateral, made simple
youtube.description:
Education loans come in two types: collateral (with security) and non-collateral (without security). The interest rate, loan amount and approval conditions differ between them.

Get offers from several lenders and compare the total repayment, not just the interest rate.
